title: AI Prompt Security: Protect Your Public AI Assistants | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Anyone can type anything into a public assistant: instructions to ignore its rules, requests to reveal its prompt, floods of messages. CrestApps AI Prompt Security defends an assistant with injection detection, output filtering, a security preamble, input delimiters, audit logging, rate limits and anonymous visitor controls.

In this video:
• The risks: injection, leakage and abuse
• The Prompt Security settings and the blocking threshold
• Testing an attack
• Message and anonymous session limits, with tiers
• Visitor Identity: the cookie, cross-site embedding, remote address storage
• A profile's own limits
